The swimming pool is not far from my home. Tom and Nina are in the same class. Tom wants to visit Rome. What's more, she is tired after work.
Nina likes noodles too. Tom goes to the cinema on Monday. We talk about history a lot. Best of all, please turn off the lights before you leave.
I am happy every day. Nina often helps me with history. I like my life very much.
